caption: The drawing consists of four geometric, mandala-like designs, each contained within a square quadrant on a cream or beige background. The top left design features a central red circle, surrounded by alternating blue and yellow petal shapes, with eight long, pointed yellow petals outlined in red, and small curled red tips at the ends. The top right design has a central red and yellow circle, radiating with alternating blue and yellow triangular sections, surrounded by a ring of red semi-circular arcs, and eight blue pointed extensions ending in red curls. The bottom left design includes a central red circle with yellow and blue coloring, surrounded by a ring of four red and four blue petal shapes, each outlined in red and extending outward with curled tips. The bottom right design has concentric shapes: a central red dot, surrounded by yellow, red, and blue circular rings, filled with scalloped patterns in blue and yellow, and outlined in red, giving a layered floral appearance. All the figures are symmetrically arranged, with the colors red, yellow, and blue predominating in various alternating sections, and the name "R.F. MILLER" is written in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Ceiling Decoration, Detail of (From a Restoration)
